---- MODULE Inc ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANT N
(* --algorithm Inc
variables total = 0;
process worker \in 1..N
variables tmp = 0;
begin

  Read:
    tmp := total;
  Write:
    total := tmp + 1;

end process;
end algorithm; *)
\* BEGIN TRANSLATION (chksum(pcal) = "fff14126" /\ chksum(tla) = "d00de013")
VARIABLES total, pc, tmp

vars == << total, pc, tmp >>

ProcSet == (1..N)

Init == (* Global variables *)
        /\ total = 0
        (* Process worker *)
        /\ tmp = [self \in 1..N |-> 0]
        /\ pc = [self \in ProcSet |-> "Read"]

Read(self) == /\ pc[self] = "Read"
              /\ tmp' = [tmp EXCEPT ![self] = total]
              /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "Write"]
              /\ total' = total

Write(self) == /\ pc[self] = "Write"
               /\ total' = tmp[self] + 1
               /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "Done"]
               /\ tmp' = tmp

worker(self) == Read(self) \/ Write(self)

(* Allow infinite stuttering to prevent deadlock on termination. *)
Terminating == /\ \A self \in ProcSet: pc[self] = "Done"
               /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == (\E self \in 1..N: worker(self))
           \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Termination == <>(\A self \in ProcSet: pc[self] = "Done")

\* END TRANSLATION 

Done == \A p \in 1..N : pc[p] = "Done"
Correct == Done => total = N
====
